[[File:Ion_Pulse_Missiles.png|thumb|right|250px|An ion pulse missile.]]
'''Ion missiles''', with some varieties called '''ion pulse missiles''', were [[Warhead/Legends|warheads]] designed to disable craft in a similar way to [[Ion cannon/Legends|Ion cannons]] or [[Conner net]]s. More comprehensive in their effect than [[Mag-pulse warhead/Legends|magnetic pulse]] warheads, which simply knocked out weapons systems, they permitted craft without ion cannons to be used in disabling operations.

This was highly useful for a group such as the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], who were often dependent on old or non-military vessels, in that they added immense flexibility to otherwise less-useful [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]].

During the investigation into the [[TIE Experimental Project]] by cruiser [[Liberty/Legends|''Liberty'']], ion pulse warheads were successfully used by the [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]] ''[[Bandit Squadron]]'' to disable examples of a [[TIE Experimental M2|TIE BigGun]], a [[TIE Experimental M3|TIE Warhead]], and a modified [[Beta-class ETR-3 escort transport|''Beta''-class ETR-3 escort transport]] from ''[[Suluk]]'' group. The ion pulse warheads permitted undamaged enemy craft to be retrieved for later analysis by Alliance [[Technician/Legends|technicians]].
